    return y * 2.0
}

function main() -> i32 {
    let s = n |> Stats {
        doubled = twice,
        squared = square,
    }
    players |> sort by [.name] stable
    players |> sort descending unique with entropy(seed: 42) gpu
    return 0
}

theorem «List» «reverse» «double reverse» (a: Nat, b: Nat) {
    assume Nat/+.zero-left(a)
    therefore rev(rev(cons(a, nil))) == cons(a, nil)
}
